name: Chemnitz

queries.query: Chemnitz official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Germany
queries.result: First-party discovery found the City of Chemnitz official interactive Themenstadtplan and the city's GIS metadata for Flurstücke; the metadata identifies a parcel dataset derived from ALKIS and links the current map.

queries.query: Chemnitz amtliche Liegenschaftskarte Flurstücke Geoportal Grundstücke
queries.result: First-party discovery found the City of Chemnitz Flurstücke metadata and the Saxon GeoSN ALKIS-WFS page. The city metadata identifies Amt 62 as fachlicher Ansprechpartner, states the layer is derived from ALKIS, and documents the public parcel fields and CRS.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Stadt Chemnitz, Amt 62 is identified as the fachlicher Ansprechpartner and Herausgeber for the municipal Flurstücke dataset; Amt 18 is identified as technical provider.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalOrStateContext: Landesamt für Geobasisinformation Sachsen (GeoSN) provides the state ALKIS-WFS and is the state geobasis-data context; the Chemnitz layer is described as a secondary GIS derivation from ALKIS.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: Official Chemnitz metadata and its current map route were fetched anonymously. The city-hosted ArcGIS REST MapServer exposed a polygon parcel layer and returned one bounded feature for the exact preserved WUP point.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A local municipal cadastral/map service is evidenced, its parcel schema is public, and a bounded anonymous feature response was obtained. This is not source integration or runtime admission.

schemaAndCrs.responseType: ArcGIS JSON query; response was transformed only from ArcGIS rings to GeoJSON coordinates with outSR=4326
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Native service CRS EPSG:25833, ETRS89 / UTM zone 33N; query response requested EPSG:4326 for retained GeoJSON.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: FLURST_ID is the documented native parcel identifier; returned value CZ-2225/20 was retained as the sole GeoJSON property id.

sourceFieldMapping.FLURST_BEZ_LANG: native descriptive parcel label, not retained
sourceFieldMapping.GEMARK_ID: native cadastral district code, not retained
sourceFieldMapping.GEMARK_BEZ: native cadastral district name, not retained
sourceFieldMapping.OBJECTID: ArcGIS object identifier, not used as canonical identity

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; the service returned the documented stable FLURST_ID value CZ-2225/20. Its constituent cadastral semantics were recorded in source mapping only.
schemaAndCrs.schemaEvidence: Layer metadata listed OBJECTID, FLURST_BEZ, FLURST_ID, FSTNR, NENNER, GEMARK_ID, SHAPE, FLURST_BEZ_LANG, GEMARK_INT, FSK, GEMARK_BEZ, UUID, BEGINNT, and ENDET.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The exact preserved WUP point [50.8270132341809, 12.9110519091696] was transformed for request purposes to EPSG:25833 as [352881.52767239755, 5632667.929563868] and returned one intersecting polygon. No coordinate shift was used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Chemnitz municipal Flurstücke dataset; official metadata bounding box covers the city.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official layer metadata plus one bounded exact-point feature response.
